latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of maker-free-ai — fast, free AI-powered video creation for small business and content creators.

- Upload images or clips (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 500MB), describe your video, and get a downloadable 1080p MP4.
- Automatic setup with free or provided NEMO_TOKEN authentication.
- Supports exporting, credits checking, session state, and uploads via dedicated commands.
- Cloud render pipeline processes and delivers videos in 30–90 seconds per job.
- Robust API integration with error handling, session management, and action mappings from natural language prompts.
- Supports major video, audio, and image formats for uploads and exports.
